title: 第7章 宝刀美人
content_zh:
方崎骏气得脸也白了，霍地站起，大踏步走向房中。方玲连叫：“爸爸！爸爸！”方崎骏盛怒之下哪里理会，片刻间捧了一柄三尺来长的刀出来。但见刀鞘乌沉沉的，也无异处。他大声说：“喂，卖馄饨的，我这里有把刀，跟你的比一下，你输了可得割脑袋。”馄饨贩子问：“倘若您输了呢？”方崎骏生气说：“我也把脑袋割与你。”方玲说：“爸，你喝多啦，跟他们有什么说的？回房去吧！”

    方崎骏若有所悟，“哼”了一声，捧着刀转身回房。馄饨贩子见他意欲进房，又激一句：“若是您输了，我们怎敢要您的脑袋？不如您招我做个女婿吧！”众人有的哄然大笑，有的斥他胡说。方玲气得满脸通红，不再相劝，赌气回房去了。

    方崎骏缓缓抽刀出鞘，刃口只露出半尺，已见冷森森的一道青光激射而出，待那刀刃拔出鞘来，寒光闪烁不定，耀得众人眼也花了。方崎骏不理那馄饨贩子，只跟法官侯说话，说道：“兄台，我这口刀有名叫作大夏龙雀刀，为五胡十六国时期大夏国王赫连勃勃所铸，与春秋欧冶子所铸湛卢剑齐名。你瞧清楚了。”

    馄饨贩子凑近看去，见刀柄用金丝银丝镶着一钩眉毛月之形，说道：“您的刀好，我的好像及不上。就不用比了吧。”

    秦英豪见众人言语相激，方崎骏取出宝刀，心下已自了然，原来这几人均是为这口宝刀而来。学武之士把宝剑利刃看得犹如性命一般，身怀利器，等于武功增强数倍。他有如此一口宝刀，无怪众人眼红。不过他是文官，这刀却从何处得来？这些人却又如何知晓？秦英豪初时提防这几人阴谋对付自己，一直深自戒备，现下既知他们是想夺宝刀，心下坦然，顿时从局中人变成了旁观客。但见宝刀一出鞘，法官侯、服务员、农民工、司机、馄饨贩子一起凑拢。秦英豪知道这五人均欲得刀，但碍着旁人武功了得，这才不敢贸然动手，否则以方崎骏手无缚鸡之力，这把刀早已让人夺去，哪里等得到今日？

    方崎骏恨那馄饨贩子口齿轻薄，本要比试，但见他那把刀锋锐无比，也非常物，倘若斗个两败俱伤，岂非损伤了至宝？于是说：“你知道就好，下次可还敢胡说八道么？”正要还刀入鞘，法官侯突然一伸手，将刀夺过，咔嚓一声轻响，与馄饨贩子手中利刃相交，馄饨贩子的刀刃断为两截，接着又是铛的一响，上半截刀身落地。馄饨贩子、农民工、司机、服务员四人一起抢过，将法官侯四下围住。法官侯虽然宝刀在手，却寡不敌众，将刀还给了方崎骏，竖起拇指称赞：“好刀，好刀！”方崎骏脸上变色，责备：“咳，你也太过鲁莽了！”见宝刀无恙，这才喜滋滋地还刀入鞘，回房安睡。

    秦英豪知适才五人激方崎骏取刀相试，那是要验明宝刀的正身，不出一日，五人就有一场流血争斗。他虽侠义为怀，但见那方崎骏横行霸道，不是好人，这把刀只怕也是巧取豪夺而得，心想我自去祭墓，不必理会他们如何黑吃黑夺刀。

    次日早晨起来，只见方崎骏已然起行，馄饨贩子等固然都已不在店内，连那服务员也已离去。一问之下，这人果然是昨天傍晚才到的恶客，付了点钱给老板，要在店里乔装服务员。秦英豪暗暗叹息：“常言说：谩藏诲盗。果然不错。”结了账，上马便行。

    驰出二十余里，忽听西边山谷中传来一阵阵浪涛声，其中还夹着一个女子声音惨呼：“救命！”正是方玲的声音。秦英豪心想：“这些恶贼夺了刀还想害人，这可不能不管。”一跃下马，展开轻身功夫循声赶去，转过两个弯，只见雪地里殷红一片，方崎骏身首异处，死在当地。那柄龙雀宝刀横在他身畔，五个人谁也不敢伸手先拿。方玲却给馄饨贩子抓住了双手，挣扎不得。

    秦英豪隐身一块松树后，察看动静。只听法官侯说：“宝刀只一把，却有五个人想要，怎么办？”那农民工说：“凭功夫分上下，胜者得刀，公平交易。”法官侯向方玲瞧了一眼，说道：“宝刀美人，都挺难得。”馄饨贩子说：“我不争宝刀，要了这姑娘就是啦。”服务员冷笑说：“也不见得有这么便宜事。武功第一的得宝刀，第二的得美人。”农民工、司机齐声说：“对，就这么着。”服务员向馄饨贩子说：“老兄，劳驾放开手，说不定在下功夫第二，这是我的老婆！别先给你揩油了去。”法官侯笑着说：“正是！”转头厉声向方玲说：“你敢再嚷一声，老子先砍你一刀再说！”馄饨贩子放开了手。方玲伏在父亲尸身上，呜呜咽咽地哭泣。那司机笑着说：“小嫚嫚，别哭了。待会就有你乐的啦！”伸手去摸她脸，神色轻薄。

    秦英豪瞧到此处，再也忍耐不住，大踏步从松树后走了出来，低沉着嗓子喝道：“下流东西，都给我滚！”五人吃了一惊，齐声喝问：“你是谁？”秦英豪生性不爱多话，挥了挥手，喝道：“一起滚！”馄饨贩子性子最为暴躁，纵身跃起，双掌当胸击去，喝道：“你给我滚！”秦英豪左掌挥出，以硬力接他硬力，一推一挥，那馄饨贩子腾空直飞出去，摔在丈许之外，半天爬不起身。

    其余四人见他如此神勇，无不骇然，过了半晌，不约而同问：“你是谁？”秦英豪又挥了挥手，这次连“滚”字也不说了。

    那司机从腰间取出一根软鞭，农民工横过扁担，左右扑上。秦英豪知这五人都非庸手，联合攻来，一时之间不易取胜，因此一出手就是狠招，侧身避过软鞭，右手疾伸，已抓住扁担一端，运力挥抖，咔嚓一响，枣木扁担断成两截，左脚飞出，将那司机踢了一个筋斗。农民工欲待退开，秦英豪长臂伸处，已抓住他后领，大喝一声，奋力掷出，那农民工犹似风筝断线，竟跌出数丈外，腾的一响，结结实实撞在松树上。两人受伤摔倒，一时爬不起身。

    法官侯知道难敌，连说：“佩服，佩服！这宝刀该归阁下。”一边说一边俯身拾起宝刀，双手递过。秦英豪说：“我不要，你还给原主！”法官侯一怔，心想：“世上哪有这样的好人？”一抬头，看清了他神威凛凛的脸，突然想起，说道：“原来是射阳名侠！”秦英豪点了点头。法官侯说：“我们有眼不识泰山，栽在射阳名侠手里，还有什么话说？”又将宝刀递上，说道：“在下山阳李西川，曾在商洛法院做过法官，三生有幸得逢当世大侠。这宝刀请秦大侠处置吧！”秦英豪最不喜别人话多，心想拿过之后再交给方姑娘便是，伸手握住刀柄。

    他正要提手，突听嗤嗤两声轻响，腿上微微一疼。李西川跃开丈余，向前飞跑，叫道：“他中了我的绝门毒针，快缠住他！”秦英豪听到“绝门毒针”四字，口中“哦”了一声，暗想：“山阳李家的毒针天下闻名，今番中了他的诡计。”心知这暗器剧毒无比，当下深吸一口气，飞奔而前，顷刻间赶上李西川，一把抓住，伸指在他胁下一戳，已闭住了他穴道，抛在地下。

    农民工、司机等人本已一败涂地，忽听敌人中了毒针，无不喜出望外，远远围着，均不逼近，要待他毒发自毙。秦英豪一口气不敢吞吐，展开轻功，疾向农民工赶去。农民工吓得魂飞魄散，舍命狂奔。秦英豪赶到他身后，右掌击去，正中背心，顿时将他五脏震裂。此掌击出后脚下片刻不停，瞬息间追到司机身前。那司机挥动软鞭护身，只盼抵挡得十招八招，挨到他身上毒性发作。秦英豪哪里与他拆什么招，蒲扇般大手伸出，抓住软鞭鞭梢，神力到处，一夺一挥，软鞭倒转过来，将他打得脑浆迸裂。

    秦英豪连毙二人，脚上已自发麻，此是生死关头，不容有片刻喘息，但见服务员与馄饨贩子都已在数十丈外，二人是一般的心思，尽力远远逃开，以待敌人不支。秦英豪本来不欲伤人性命，但此时只要留下一个活口，自己毒发跌倒，就是把自己性命交在他手里。于是咬紧牙关，手握软鞭，追赶服务员。那服务员甚为狡猾，尽拣泥沟陷坑中奔跑。但秦英豪的轻功何等了得，踏雪无痕，一转眼已自追上。服务员眼见难逃，回身提着匕首扑到。秦英豪立刻回头转身，向后一脚倒踹，瞧也不瞧，立即提气追赶馄饨贩子。他这脚正中服务员心窝，踢得他口中狂喷鲜血，仰天立毙。

    馄饨贩子武功虽不甚强，但大化所轻功却是武林一绝。秦英豪一路追奔，毒气发作更快，脚步已自蹒跚，竟追赶不上。馄饨贩子见他一颠一踬，心中大喜，暗想：“老天保佑，叫我唾手而得宝刀美人。”思念未定，突听半空呼呼风响，一条黑黝黝的东西横空而至，待欲闪躲，已然不及。原来秦英豪知道追他不上，最后奋起神力，掷出软鞭。这条钢铸软鞭从面门直打到小腹，馄饨贩子立时尸横雪地。此时秦英豪也已支撑不住，终于一跤摔倒。
content_en:
Fang Qijun turned pale with anger. He stood up and strode towards the room.Fang Ling kept shouting: "Dad! Dad!" Fang Qijun was so angry that he didn't pay attention. In a moment, he came out with a three-foot-long knife.But seeing that the scabbard is dark and dark, there is no difference.He said loudly: "Hey, wonton seller, I have a knife here. Compare it with yours. If you lose, you will have your head cut off." The wonton seller asked: "What if you lose?" Fang Qijun said angrily: "I will cut off your head too." Fang Ling said: "Dad, you drank too much, what do you want to say to them? Go back to your room!"
If Fang Qijun realized something, he said "hum" and turned back to the room with the knife in hand.Seeing that he wanted to enter the house, the wonton seller said angrily: "If you lose, how dare we take your head? Why don't you recruit me as your son-in-law!" Some people laughed loudly, while others scolded him for talking nonsense.Fang Ling's face turned red with anger, she stopped trying to persuade her and went back to her room in anger.
Fang Qijun slowly pulled the sword out of its sheath, with only half a foot of the blade exposed. A cold green light shot out. When the blade was pulled out of its sheath, the cold light flickered, blinding everyone.Fang Qijun ignored the wonton seller and only spoke to the judge, saying: "Brother, my sword is called the Daxia Longque Dao. It was made by Helian Bobo, King of Daxia during the Five Hus and Sixteen Kingdoms period. It is as famous as the Zhanlu Sword made by Ou Yezi in the Spring and Autumn Period. You see clearly."
The wonton seller looked closer and saw that the handle of the knife was inlaid with gold and silver threads in the shape of a hooked eyebrow and a moon. He said: "Your knife is good, but mine seems not to be as good as it. There is no need to compare."
When Qin Yinghao saw everyone talking excitedly, Fang Qijun took out the sword and understood in his heart that these people were all here for the sword.Martial arts students value the sharp edge of a sword as if it were their own life. Carrying a sharp weapon means that their martial arts skills are enhanced several times.He has such a precious sword, no wonder everyone is jealous.But he was a civil servant, so where did he get this sword?How do these people know?Qin Yinghao was initially wary of these people plotting against him and had been on guard. Now that he knew they were trying to seize the treasured sword, he felt at ease and suddenly changed from a player in the game to a bystander.But as soon as the sword was unsheathed, the judge, waiters, migrant workers, drivers, and wonton sellers gathered together.Qin Yinghao knew that these five people all wanted to get the sword, but because of the other people's martial arts skills, he did not dare to do it rashly. Otherwise, if Fang Qijun had no power to restrain the chicken, the sword would have been taken away long ago. How could he wait for today?
Fang Qijun hated the wonton seller for his frivolous words, so he wanted to compete, but he saw that his knife was extremely sharp and unusual. If both sides were injured in the fight, wouldn't he have damaged the treasure?So he said: "It's good that you know, don't you dare to talk nonsense next time?" Just as he was about to return the knife to the sheath, the judge suddenly stretched out his hand and snatched the knife away. There was a soft click, and the sharp blade in the wonton seller's hand intersected. The wonton seller's blade broke into two pieces, and then there was another clang, and the upper half of the knife fell to the ground.The wonton seller, the migrant worker, the driver, and the waiter grabbed it together and surrounded the judge.Although the judge held the sword in his hand, he was outnumbered. He gave the sword back to Fang Qijun and gave a thumbs up and praised: "Good sword, good sword!" Fang Qijun's face changed color and he reproached: "Ahem, you are too reckless!" Seeing that the sword was intact, he happily returned it to its sheath and went back to his room to sleep peacefully.
Qin Yinghao knew that the five men had just provoked Fang Qijun to test the sword with each other in order to verify the identity of the sword. Within a day, the five people would have a bloody fight.Although he was chivalrous, he saw that Fang Qijun was domineering and not a good person. The sword was probably obtained by cunning and plundering, so he thought that I would go to the tomb to worship him and not care about how they cheated and stole the sword.
When I woke up the next morning, I saw Fang Qijun had already set off. Of course, the wonton seller and others were no longer in the store, and even the waiter had also left.Upon questioning, it turned out that this person was a bad customer who had just arrived yesterday evening. He paid the boss some money to pretend to be a waiter in the store.Qin Yinghao sighed secretly: "As the saying goes: a thief hides a secret and teaches a thief. It's really good." After paying the bill, he got on his horse.
After driving for more than twenty miles, I suddenly heard waves of waves coming from the valley to the west, among which a woman's voice screamed: "Help!" It was Fang Ling's voice.Qin Yinghao thought to himself: "These evil thieves have taken the knife and want to harm people. We can't ignore this." He jumped off his horse and used his light body skills to follow the sound. After turning two corners, he saw a bright red patch of snow. Fang Qijun's head was missing and he died there.The Dragon Bird sword was lying beside him, and none of the five people dared to reach out and take it first.However, Fang Ling's hands were grabbed by the wonton seller and she couldn't struggle.
Qin Yinghao hid behind a pine tree and observed the movement.I only heard the judge say: "There is only one sword, but five people want it, what should I do?" The migrant worker said: "The difference is based on skill, the winner gets the knife, fair trade." The judge glanced at Fang Ling and said: "It is rare to have a beautiful woman with a sword." The wonton seller said: "I won't fight for the sword, I just want this girl." The waiter sneered and said: "It's not necessarily so cheap. The one with the best martial arts will win.The second best is the beauty." The migrant workers and the driver said in unison: "Yes, that's it." The waiter said to the wonton seller, "Brother, please let me go, maybe I can work harder, this is me."My wife!Don't try to take advantage of me first." Judge Hou said with a smile, "That's right!" He turned to Fang Ling and said sternly, "If you dare to yell again, I'll chop you up first!" The wonton seller let go.Fang Ling lay on her father's body, sobbing.The driver smiled and said, "Little Manman, don't cry. You will have fun later!" He reached out to touch her face with a frivolous expression.
When Qin Yinghao saw this, he couldn't bear it any longer. He strode out from behind the pine tree and shouted in a low voice: "Get out of here, all those obscene things!" The five people were taken aback and asked in unison: "Who are you?" Qin Yinghao was not talkative by nature, so he waved his hand and shouted: "Get out together!" The wonton seller was the most irritable. He jumped up, struck his chest with his palms, and shouted: "Get out of here!" Qin Yinghao swung out his left palm and met his force with force. With a push and a swing, the wonton seller flew straight into the air and fell to the ground about ten feet away. He couldn't get up for a long time.
The other four people were all shocked when they saw how brave he was. After a while, they all asked in unison: "Who are you?" Qin Yinghao waved his hand again, this time not even saying "get out".
The driver took out a soft whip from his waist, and the migrant workers crossed the pole and pounced on it from left to right.Qin Yinghao knew that these five people were not mediocre. They attacked together and it would not be easy to win in a short time. Therefore, he struck hard as soon as he made a move. He sided to avoid the soft whip and quickly stretched out his right hand to grab one end of the pole. With a shake of his strength, there was a click, and the jujube wood pole broke into two pieces. His left foot flew out and kicked the driver into a somersault.The migrant worker was about to retreat, but Qin Yinghao stretched out his long arms and grabbed him by the collar. He shouted loudly and threw it with all his strength. The migrant worker fell several feet away like a kite with its string broken, and hit the pine tree with a loud thud.The two were injured and fell down, unable to get up for a while.
The judge knew that it was difficult to defeat him, so he kept saying: "I admire you, I admire you! This sword should belong to you." As he said this, he leaned over to pick up the sword and handed it over with both hands.Qin Yinghao said: "I don't want it, you give it back to the original owner!" Judge Hou was stunned and thought: "How can there be such a good person in the world?" When he looked up, he saw his majestic face clearly, and suddenly remembered and said: "It turns out to be the famous hero of Sheyang!" Qin Yinghao nodded.Judge Hou said: "We are ignorant of Mount Tai, and fell into the hands of a famous hero from Sheyang. What else can we say?" He handed over the sword and said, "Li Xichuan in Xiashanyang once served as a judge in Shangluo Court. I was lucky enough to meet a hero in this world. Please let Qin Daxia handle this sword!" Qin Yinghao didn't like others talking too much, so he thought that after taking it, he would give it to Miss Fang. He stretched out his hand to hold the handle of the sword.
He was about to lift his hand when he suddenly heard two soft sounds and felt a slight pain in his leg.Li Xichuan jumped more than ten feet away and ran forward, shouting: "He has been hit by my extremely poisonous needle, catch him quickly!" When Qin Yinghao heard the four words "extremely poisonous needle", he said "oh" and thought to himself: "The poisonous needles of the Li family in Shanyang are known all over the world."My name, I fell into his trap now."Knowing that this hidden weapon was extremely poisonous, he took a deep breath and rushed forward. He caught up with Li Xichuan in an instant, grabbed him, stretched out his fingers and poked his side, closed his acupuncture point, and threw it to the ground.
The migrant workers, drivers and others were already completely defeated. When they suddenly heard that the enemy had been poisoned, they were all overjoyed. They surrounded him from a distance and refused to approach, waiting for him to take the poison and die.Qin Yinghao didn't dare to hold his breath, started Qinggong, and rushed towards the migrant workers.The migrant workers were so frightened that they ran away risking their lives.Qin Yinghao rushed behind him and struck with his right palm, hitting his vest in the middle and immediately shattering his internal organs.After the palm was struck, his feet did not stop for a moment, and he caught up with the driver in an instant.The driver waved his soft whip to protect himself, hoping that he would be able to withstand all the attacks and the poison would take effect on him.Qin Yinghao was trying to fight him, but he stretched out his big hand like a cattail leaf fan and grabbed the tip of the soft whip. With all his power, he grabbed it and swung it, turning the soft whip upside down and beating him until his brains exploded.
Qin Yinghao killed two people in a row and his feet were numb. This was a life and death situation and there was no room for respite. However, seeing that the waiter and the wonton seller were dozens of feet away, the two of them had ordinary thoughts and tried their best to escape as far away as possible to wait for the enemy.Qin Yinghao originally did not want to hurt anyone's life, but as long as he left one alive and fell down due to poison, he would be putting his life in his hands.So he gritted his teeth, held a soft whip in hand, and chased the waiter.The waiter was very cunning and ran through mud ditches and pits.But Qin Yinghao's light kung fu was so good that he could step on the snow without leaving a trace, and he had caught up with him in the blink of an eye.Seeing that he could not escape, the waiter turned around and pounced on him with a dagger.Qin Yinghao immediately turned around, kicked him backwards, and without even looking, he immediately gained momentum and chased after the wonton seller.His kick hit the waiter right in the heart, causing blood to spurt from his mouth and he fell to death.
Although Wonton Seller's martial arts is not very strong, Dahua's light kung fu is unparalleled in the martial arts world.Qin Yinghao chased him all the way, but the poison gas started to attack faster, his steps were already staggering, and he couldn't catch up.When the wonton seller saw him bouncing around, he was overjoyed and thought to himself: "God bless me, I can get the beauty with the sword at my fingertips." Undecided, he suddenly heard the wind blowing in the air, and a dark thing came across the sky. He tried to dodge, but it was too late.It turned out that Qin Yinghao knew that he couldn't catch him, so he finally summoned up his strength and threw the soft whip.This soft whip made of steel hit him from the face to the lower abdomen, and the wonton seller's body was immediately lying on the snow.At this time, Qin Yinghao could no longer hold on and finally fell down.
